description: Your role What You'll Be Doing Senior Software Engineer What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Software Engineer within our Alpha division. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will build secure, resilient, and scalable software solutions that support business-critical financial services. Continuously identify opportunities to improve software quality, operational efficiency, engineering processes, and system performance. Communicate technical solutions and progress effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong experience developing applications using C# and modern .NET. Strong experience designing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless architectures. Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture. Strong experience designing and developing event-driven applications using messaging and event streaming technologies such as Amazon EventBridge, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or similar. Experience designing and developing reusable backend services, RESTful APIs, and system integrations. Experience building workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modelling and performance optimisation. Experience defining and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with practical experience of AWS CloudFormation. Good understanding of Kubernetes and modern cloud deployment environments. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability practices for production systems. Strong understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices. Experience designing highly available, resilient, business-critical software systems. Ability to analyse complex business processes and design scalable software solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. Nice to Have Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries.
